"...Damn it, I'm wet again."
"Then I'll show you how I do it, so according to our contract, you have to show me too, noona."
...She thought she'd gotten herself a harmless little deer, but it seems she'd actually gotten tangled up with a sly, lecherous nine-tailed fox.
